crime: During afternoon free time, {WITCH_NAME} and another girl recorded short readings from ordinary library books on the girl's phone. The girl enjoyed choosing passages and sharing the recordings with the other prisoners. {WITCH_NAME} treasured being the chosen reader and looked forward to each new session.

One day, the girl brought an unfamiliar page and said its first reading would decide whether they kept working together. Repeated takes had begun to consume the time she wanted for choosing and sharing passages. {WITCH_NAME} stumbled near the end and asked to start again. The girl refused, said the decision had been made, and ended their partnership.

The girl said the recording was over and placed the phone face down. {WITCH_NAME} kept staring at the girl with her hands clenched. Frightened, the girl secretly left the file running, picked up the phone, and left the library for the recreation room. {WITCH_NAME} followed her into the second-floor hall beside the iron railing over the courtyard.

Other prisoners heard a fall and found the girl dead in the courtyard. {WITCH_NAME} admitted following her, but said she had only wanted to apologize. According to {WITCH_NAME}, the girl pulled away, lost her balance, and fell before she could catch her.

The phone in the girl's pocket held one continuous recording from the failed reading through the fall. It captured {WITCH_NAME} saying that the girl's next move would fail, the girl telling her to stop pushing, a body striking the railing, and the fall. {WITCH_NAME} had chosen failure and then pushed the girl toward the railing. The girl's first attempt to regain her balance or catch the rail failed, and she fell before she could try again. The recording proved that {WITCH_NAME} had not failed to rescue the girl; she had used her magic to prevent the girl from saving herself.
fields.epitaph: She settled every outcome but the coin's final fall.
fields.epithet: The Page Without a Second Take
execution: An iron coin taller and wider than she is stands on its edge. A check mark covers one face, a cross covers the other, and tally cuts ring its rim. The coin spins, then wobbles toward her. Its rim strikes her shoulders and knocks her onto her back before the broad face crashes across her head, ribs, and chest. Her skull and chest are crushed beneath it.

magic.name: Outcome Decree
magic.text: She can decide whether another person's next attempted action succeeds or fails.
